briefs: Product-mockup, portrait 4:5 luxury Korean stationery editorial photograph. Design a NEW version of Charim — A Tea Diary. Reference 1 is the old diary for brand continuity; reference 2 is the EXACT five rounded petal OUTLINE flower with a small center dot: reproduce this silhouette accurately. Make the diary clearly HARDCOVER with substantial wrapped boards, rounded square corners, a visible narrow rounded sewn spine, ivory page block and two slim celadon and ivory ribbon bookmarks. A6, approximately 80 interior pages, restrained proportions not an enormous thick journal. Cover is deep ink-black fine bookcloth, with a small vertically oriented ivory hanji-like paper title slip near upper right reading only '차림' in elegant black Korean serif, and below it tiny English 'A Tea Diary'. A generously spaced minimal iridescent mother-of-pearl PRINTED outline flower logo centered on the black cover, luminous silvery celadon, slight pale pink and blue nacre, not gold. Quiet Joseon book-inspired composition, a contemporary interpretation NOT a historical reproduction, no imitation stitched stab binding on the outside. Modern customizable diary details: a removable pale celadon narrow fabric closure band; a small detachable silver-tone flower bookmark charm resting beside it; one loose ivory name card reading '나의 차 기록' and a few refined small celadon/ivory blank index tabs and two simple flower seal stickers arranged neatly beside the book. No cartoon characters, no royal dragon, no clutter, no other logos. One closed black diary in three-quarter view on softly textured warm-white hanji surface; tactile clear materials, sharp professional studio light. Product concept, not a real manufactured product. Only lettering listed above; no watermark.

Product-mockup, landscape 3:2 high resolution studio photograph. Reference image is the EXACT brand emblem: minimal FIVE rounded petal OUTLINE flower and one small CENTER DOT. Create Charim's premium embroidered Korean tea handkerchief square, pale muted celadon cotton-linen with fine visible weave, approximately 40cm square concept. Show one square partially unfolded with a gently folded corner, narrow clean stitched hem and tasteful tone-on-tone edge stitch. Near one corner embroider the exact flower outline in warm ivory silky thread, actual raised fine satin stitches clearly visible, central dot stitched in ivory. SMALL discreet logo about 20mm across relative to 40cm cloth, not huge. Beside it include a small folded black paper sleeve with the same outline flower rendered in subtle silver/celadon nacre PRINT finish and tiny text '차림', 'CHARIM'. Soft neutral ivory hanji surface, directional daylight and realistic fabric shadows. Contemporary Korean elegance, Joseon-inspired restraint in color and textile, black white celadon palette. Macro detail is readable but whole cloth is visible, tactile fiber detail. No printed logo on the fabric: it MUST be thread embroidery. No other props, no gold, no flowers, no text overlay, no watermark. A proposed product design concept.

Product-mockup, landscape 3:2 high resolution luxury Korean tea packaging editorial photo. Reference image is EXACT logo minimal five rounded petal outline flower + small central dot, retain its outline shape and center dot; do not replace with filled flower or old leaf logo. Create ink-black Charim Korean tea packaging family: one CLOSED matte black rigid tea gift box, one matching black resealable stand-up tea pouch beside it, and one small black tea sample envelope. Every principal logo is a printed mother-of-pearl effect using restrained silver, pale celadon, faint pink-blue highlights, NO GOLD. The flower logo is the main artwork centered large on gift box and smaller on tea pouch. Very subtle fine najeon-inspired plum branch pattern confined to the box lower corner; generous blank black space, refined Korean contemporary minimalist composition. On box typography '차림' and 'CHARIM'. On pouch '차림', 'KOREAN GREEN TEA', and tiny 'millionroutines'; don't invent tea weight, producer, harvest or certification. Gift box has a celadon inner-paper sliver at lid seam, no huge ribbon. Place on warm white hanji with tiny celadon cloth edge under box, tactile black paper, fine iridescent printed logo effect visible in raking light. Clearly printed nacre-inspired finish, not real shell inlay and no rough glued shell. Crisp natural studio photograph three-quarter angle, no people, no extra notebook, no teaware, no text outside packaging, no watermark. This is a new design concept, not actual production photography.
open: Edit this OPEN tea diary mockup. Preserve the exact legible interior text, warm-white 80-page A6 paper proportions, page layout, lines, position, framing and headings The Cup / The Moment. Change ONLY the physical binding and small stationery details: green flexible cloth edges become clearly defined deep ink-black bookcloth HARDCOVER boards visible around all three sides, approximately 2mm thick boards, fine sewn center gutter, cream endpapers, with the black hardcover spine. Include two narrow satin ribbon bookmarks (pale celadon and ivory) emerging below the book, and two small blank celadon index tabs on right paper edge. Keep all pages blank no handwriting. No new ornate historical motifs, no changing typography, no extra separate book, no logos inside pages. Contemporary Korean stationery editorial photo, quiet Joseon-inspired material restraint, high resolution realistic sharp studio photography. This is a proposed concept mockup.
bundle: Edit the open Charim tea bundle in image 1 to match the NEW black packaging direction in image 2 and embroidered cloth in image 3. Preserve the camera angle, layout, all ceramic vessels, exact two cups and side-handle teapot, cooling bowl, protective ivory insert compartments, walnut tray, guide and card. Change all visible outer box walls and lid rim to matte ink BLACK, retaining ivory fitted interior insert and existing restrained nacre floral inner lid. Replace green tea pouch with the BLACK pouch from image 2, with exact outline five-petal flower logo plus center dot in nacre-inspired PRINT, Korean title 차림 and KOREAN GREEN TEA in fine light serif. On black sleeve use an uncluttered nacre outline flower logo with subtle corner plum branch from image 2, no huge ornamental coverage. Change the wrapping cloth to a neat folded celadon handkerchief showing a SMALL ivory EMBROIDERED five-petal outline flower and central dot visibly on one corner, actual thread detail from image 3. Do not wrap it into knot that hides the logo. Keep all other objects unchanged; do not add diary or extra ceramics. Clear crisp material textures and soft natural light; physical development concept photograph. No external caption/watermark.
